## About
Larry's Plumbing is a full service plumbing and commercial electrical contractor in Franklin Park. We work for residential, commercial, industrial and municipal clients across Chicagoland. Leaks, faucets, toilets, water heaters, sewer and drain pipes, grease traps, gas lines. We handle it.
We hold State of Illinois and City of Chicago licenses and we are fully insured. Our technicians are drug tested and run fully stocked trucks. Because we are licensed, bonded and insured, we pull the permits and meet with inspectors to correct state and City of Chicago code violations. Commercial clients include Fresh Express, Whole Foods, Village of River Grove, Village of Schiller Park, USPS and Menards.
We are proud to be Veteran Owned and Women, Minority Owned. Customers rate us 4.5 on Google from 78 reviews.

## Services
- Commercial Plumbing: Plumbing for businesses and municipal clients, including ADA compliances, loading dock repairs and code violation corrections.
- Sewer Repair: Sewer and drain pipe repair, power rodding and color televising of lines.
- Residential Plumbing: Leaks, faucets, toilets, water heaters, frozen pipes, ejector pumps and gas lines for homeowners.
- Commercial Electrical: Machine wiring, interior and exterior lighting, computer wiring, security cameras and fire code issues.
- Hydro Jetting Services: High pressure jetting that cleans sludge and mud out of clogged lines. One reviewer said Ray hydro jetted and cut the roots out of his storm drain.
- Backflow Preventer Testing: Backflow testing and RPZ Valve Certification.
- Emergency Water Main Break Repairs: Water breaks and sewer main breaks, handled when they happen.
- Food Industry Emergency Plumbing Services: Emergency plumbing for food businesses, including grease traps and grease basins.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take emergency calls?
A: Yes. Emergency service is available any time, day or night.

Q: What areas do you cover?
A: The entire Chicagoland area, including Franklin Park, Melrose Park, River Grove, Schiller Park, Elmwood Park, Des Plaines and more.

Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We work for residential, commercial, industrial and municipal clients.

Q: Can I get an estimate first?
A: Yes. Call or use the form to request a no obligation estimate.

Q: Do you offer a veteran discount?
A: Yes. Our specials list a 10% Veteran Discount.
